newsitem.title: USA: WHAT A WORLD! stock delisted from Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: WHAT A WORLD! stock delisted from Nasdaq.

text.p: WHAT A WORLD! Inc said Friday that with the close of business today, its common stock and warrants will be delisted from the Nasdaq Small Cap Market due to the company's failure to meet the exchange's listing requirements.
As a result, the company's stock and warrants will be traded under the same symbols -- WHAT and WHATW -- on the bulletin board system maintained by the NASD.
WHAT A WORLD! is a specialty retailer of nature, environmental and science related gifts with 12 stores in regional malls in Florida, New York and New Jersey.
